jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Senior Software Engineer is the senior\-most technical authority for True Manufacturing's connected\-equipment software platform, owning it end to end: architecture, infrastructure, data, security, and release. This is a deeply hands\-on role — shipping production code, owning the deployment pipeline, and serving as the escalation point of last resort when the platform is down.**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.**Architecture \& Engineering*** End\-to\-end architecture: services, APIs, data model, event streams, infrastructure, security.
* Production code across a polyglot stack: Java/Spring Boot microservices, Node.js/React applications, serverless designs, and Python tooling.
* Build\-vs\-buy decisions, coding standards, and pragmatic technical\-debt reduction.

**Production \& Reliability*** Availability, observability, alerting, and incident resolution.
* Escalation point of last resort. You take ultimate responsibility for uptime and resolution.
* CI/CD, multi\-environment release management, and production deploy authority.
* Blameless post\-incident analysis; every incident becomes a runbook, a test, or a design change.

**Infrastructure \& Data*** The AWS footprint: Kubernetes workloads, infrastructure\-as\-code, IAM, secrets, and cost.
* The data layer: PostgreSQL at telemetry scale, supporting stores, and the event\-streaming topology.
* The analytics pipeline and data lake.
* The edge\-to\-cloud pipeline: device connectivity, ingestion, the device–cloud message contract, and firmware coordination with embedded engineering.

**Security*** Identity and access, enterprise SSO, multi\-tenant isolation, secrets, least\-privilege, dependency hygiene.
* Represent the platform in customer security evaluations.

**Leadership*** Architectural direction, design review, and code\-review quality gates.
* Independent command of every service and deployment path.
